what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Somalia in Egypt: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 8837 Somali asylum seekers in Egypt, 3.7% of all asylum seekers from Somalia.
Refugees from Somalia, a separate group, live mostly in Kenya and Ethiopia, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia in 1995 to 1996, 2001 to 2002 and every year from 2006 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
From 2006 the government's opponents it records include ARS/UIC, Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1515 asylum seekers, and the figure fell to a low in 2008.
It then rose again, and the main year of displacement in the data is 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Egypt.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Egypt only.
